rules.statement: The Court has a discretion to include additional land in a partition suit, but it requires a very strong case to do so, especially when the added defendants are not co-owners and merely seek protection of their equitable interests.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is a still stronger proceeding where the persons asking for such an enlargement are not co-owners, but simply persons admitted for the protection of their equitable interests. I do not say that, even under these circumstances, the Court might not give effect to the prayer of such persons in appropriate cases. Certainly the Court would have a discretion in the matter, but it would require a very strong case to induce a Court so to proceed."
